request.tone: wonder and gentle adventure; scariness mild, peril moderate, no violence
request.note: catalog book read blind; no request exists

pitch.hero: Bree, a girl who has always dreamed of the sky, stowed away on the airship Cirrus
pitch.want: to fly, make a friend, and find out what groans in the sealed hold
pitch.obstacle: a storm, a crew who would hand her to the purser, and a frightened sky-whale calf rocking the ship
pitch.stake: the Cirrus and the secret calf Nimbus, and Bree's chance to stay aboard
pitch.ending_kind: she calms, frees, shelters or reveals Nimbus to save the ship, or is set ashore with a clue

bree.name: Bree
bree.role: protagonist; a girl stowing away on the airship Cirrus
bree.want: to fly in the sky and earn a place aboard
bree.voice: close third past; brave, curious, polite to cats and crates alike

pip.name: Pip
pip.role: thin grey stray cat; Bree's friend and guide
pip.want: food and a person his size
pip.voice: mrrp; a rusty purr like a tiny engine when fed

captain_quill.name: Captain Quill
captain_quill.role: captain of the Cirrus, keeper of the secret
captain_quill.want: to get Nimbus safely to the haven and keep him secret
captain_quill.voice: dry and quick; crisp orders, rare warmth; calls Bree Stowaway

nimbus.name: Nimbus
nimbus.role: sky-whale calf hidden in the sealed hold
nimbus.want: calm, and to fly to the haven
nimbus.voice: a low hoooom that shakes when frightened

bosun.name: the bosun
bosun.role: enormous bosun who runs the deck crew
bosun.want: to keep his crew on the lines and the ship whole
bosun.voice: foghorn roar; calls Bree small fry

rigger.name: the wiry rigger
rigger.role: rigger who owns the rope-bridge and mends the envelope
rigger.want: a small climber to patch the tear

cook.name: the cook
cook.want: to know why he cooks forty buckets of mash a day

first_officer.name: the first officer
first_officer.role: tall officer, in on the secret
first_officer.want: to save the day the detour costs

purser.name: the purser
purser.role: thin officer who keeps the ledger and holds stowaways

truth.question: What is the captain secretly carrying in the sealed hold, and what steadies it?
truth.statement: The Cirrus secretly carries Nimbus, a sky-whale calf cut from a hunter's net and bound for the haven, fed forty buckets of fish mash a day and kept secret by Captain Quill. He hates thunder and loud noise; in the storm his thrashing rocks the ship, and he steadies only when someone small stays close and gentle.

bree_dreams_sky.text: Bree has dreamed about the sky for as long as she can remember.

cirrus_airship.text: The Cirrus is a great steam airship held up by a balloon; it has just cast off from a mooring tower.

captain_quill.text: Captain Quill, a woman with a dry, quick voice, commands the Cirrus.

bree_stowaway.text: Bree is a stowaway aboard the Cirrus.

bree_paying_passenger.text: Bree is a ticketed, paying passenger on the Cirrus.

bree_hid_in_coil.text: Bree came aboard hidden inside a coil of rope on the boarding deck.

four_ways_deck.text: From the boarding deck, ways lead to the engine room, the cargo hold, the crow's nest and the grand saloon.

stoker_sings.text: A big stoker in the engine room shovels coal and sings to the engine, calling it old girl.

dials_steam_lift_hold.text: A row of engine-room dials is labeled STEAM, LIFT and HOLD.

hold_kept_warm.text: The HOLD dial reads WARM, with a chalked note to keep it warm down there by order of the captain.

paw_prints_coal.text: Tiny sooty paw prints lead through the coal bunkers to a loose hatch.

small_mew_leads.text: A small half-mew, half-chirp sound leads Bree through the ship toward its middle.

eyes_behind_crate.text: In a nook of coiled rope and folded canvas near the middle of the ship, bright eyes look out at Bree from behind a crate.

stoker_heard_intruder.text: The stoker heard someone in his engine room and nearly turned to see Bree.

purser.text: The ship's purser, a thin man with a ledger, deals with caught stowaways in his office, which has a lock.

bree_no_ticket.text: Bree has no ticket, no cabin and no name in the purser's book.

bree_put_ashore.text: Bree is set ashore at the next port, her voyage over.

sad_note_below.text: A long, low, sad note hums up through the ship, too sad to be an engine.

forty_sacks_feed.text: The cargo includes forty sacks of feed, which a deckhand grumbles is enough to feed a circus.

silver_crest_crates.text: A stack of crates in the hold is stamped with a silver crest over a stenciled word.

grey_fur_tuft.text: A tuft of grey fur is caught on a barrel rim in the hold.

crest_sail_fin_fish.text: The silver crest shows a fish with fins as wide as sails leaping over three clouds.

haven_feed_stencil.text: The crested crates are stenciled HAVEN and FEED, 40 SACKS, and the sacks smell of the sea.

rag_nest_sardine_tin.text: A nest of rags with a licked-clean sardine tin in the barrel tunnel shows that somebody small lives there.

crates_unlashed.text: Some crates in the hold have come unlashed and shift and lean as the ship rolls.

cat_evaded_deckhand.text: A deckhand has chased a thin grey cat for six weeks without catching it.

cat_rescued_bree.text: The grey cat fetched a deckhand to free Bree from the crates.

bree_doesnt_know_cat_name.text: Bree does not know the grey cat's name.

crows_nest_lookout.text: A lookout keeps watch up in the crow's nest, whistling.

safety_clip.text: A safety line with a loose clip runs beside the open rungs outside the mast.

gasbags_lift.text: Inside the balloon's skin hang gasbags that hold the whole ship up.

bree_spotted_tired_seam.text: Through a spyglass Bree saw that one balloon seam near the stern looks puckered, dark and tired.

old_aft_seam.text: The riggers know an old seam near the stern that always gives way.

ship_flying_heavy.text: The lookout says the Cirrus is flying heavy in the belly this trip, as if carrying a whale.

steward_saloon.text: A smooth steward serves the passengers in the grand saloon.

model_ships_case.text: A glass case in a service room holds model ships, including a cut-open model of the Cirrus.

hidden_lowest_deck.text: On the model of the Cirrus, the lowest deck's label has been painted over, as if the deck were hidden.

something_odder_aboard.text: The steward says Bree is not the oddest thing aboard this trip, but will not say what is.

thin_grey_cat.text: A small, thin grey cat has been living aboard the Cirrus on scraps.

cat_named_pip.text: Bree names the grey cat Pip, and he takes to her as her friend.

three_ways_nook.text: From the nook, ways lead to the galley, the captain's cabin and a rope ladder into the inner rigging.

ship_cook.text: An enormous cook runs the ship's galley.

forty_buckets_mash.text: Forty buckets of fish mash are made each day for the captain's secret cargo.

pip_fed_sardines.text: Bree fed Pip a tin of sardines from the galley larder.

pip_purrs.text: When Pip is full he purrs a rusty, rumbling purr like a tiny engine.

storm_hits.text: Rough weather strikes the Cirrus: the ship lurches and a warning bell clangs.

pip_sneezed.text: Pip sneezed in the flour dust and gave Bree away to the cook.

pip_sardine_thief.text: Pip has been stealing sardines from the galley for six weeks while the cook blamed the mate.

pip_joins_ship.text: Pip is kept aboard the Cirrus as a ship's cat.

pip_in_coat.text: Bree carries Pip tucked inside her coat.

he_storm_danger.text: Captain Quill fears that if the storm catches them, he, who has not eaten since noon, will kick the ship to pieces.

storm_detour_costs_day.text: Going around the storm would cost the Cirrus a day.

crew_thinks_tea.text: The crew believe the ship is hauling tea.

he_hates_loud_noise.text: The captain's secret passenger hates thunder and any loud noise.

hold_sealed_quiet.text: The captain orders the hold kept quiet and sealed.

storm_chart.text: The captain's chart shows the ship's course bending wide around a storm.

whale_doodle_home.text: A small whale is doodled in pencil on the captain's chart, with the word HOME and an arrow pointing east.

first_officer.text: The first officer is a tall woman with rain on her coat.

seasick_calf.text: The first officer grumbles about losing a day for the sake of one seasick calf.

nimbus_sketch.text: A pencil sketch of a small whale with fins like sails is labeled NIMBUS.

officer_says_cloud.text: The first officer claims, too quickly, that a nimbus is a kind of cloud.

inner_rigging.text: Inside the ship, an inner rigging of ropes, a catwalk and a rope-bridge runs among the gasbags.

live_rope_sign.text: A board at the rope-bridge reads LIVE ROPE, CROSS LOW AND SLOW.

bree_cant_tell_seams.text: Bree cannot tell one balloon seam from another.

bree_crossed_rope_bridge.text: Bree crossed the live rope-bridge low and slow in a gust.

rigger_saw_crossing.text: A rigger watched Bree cross the rope-bridge and whistled well done.

bree_stuck_in_ropes.text: Bree rushed the rope-bridge and ended up stuck in its hand ropes.

bosun.text: The bosun is an enormous man with a voice like a foghorn.

groan_deep_hold.text: A long groan that does not sound like timber rises from the deep hold.

loose_control_line.text: A torn control line lashes about on the weather deck.

bree_caught_line.text: Bree caught the loose control line and made it fast on a cleat.

sealed_hold_door.text: A great door at the bottom of the ship is boarded SEALED BY ORDER OF THE CAPTAIN.

door_shaken_loose.text: The storm has shaken the sealed door's bolt loose, leaving a gap.

hum_follows_thunder.text: The low note from below rises when the thunder cracks and sinks when it passes.

bree_never_learns_sound.text: Nobody will tell Bree what made the sound from below.

bree_hauled_rope.text: Bree helped the crew haul the balloon rope fast in the storm.

bosun_doesnt_recognise.text: The bosun knows every hand aboard and does not recognise Bree as one of them.

bree_told_bosun.text: Bree told the bosun the truth, that she is a stowaway.

bosun_keeps_secret.text: The bosun will pretend he never heard Bree's confession until the storm is done, and sends her to look in the sealed hold.

bree_hid_identity.text: Bree slipped away without telling the bosun who she is.

bosun_doesnt_know_bree.text: The bosun does not know who Bree is.

bosun_curious_hold.text: The bosun does not know what is in the sealed hold and wishes he did.

alive_afraid_below.text: The groan from the deep hold is the sound of something alive and afraid.

huge_pale_shape.text: Something pale as a cloud and longer than a lifeboat lies shaking in the sealed hold.

shape_answers_pip.text: The great shape in the hold answers Pip's mrrp with a long, low note.

care_panel.text: A brass panel by the sealed door, signed by Captain Quill, gives feeding, tending and calming orders for its occupant.

calming_rules.text: Whoever is in the hold must be spoken to low and slow, and never shouted at or banged near.

harness_straps.text: The hold's occupant wears a leather harness whose straps must be checked.

nimbus_sky_whale_calf.text: A sky-whale calf, cloud-grey with fins like folded sails, lives in the sealed hold.

nimbus_named.text: The sky-whale calf is named Nimbus.

nimbus_from_net.text: Nimbus was cut from a hunter's net.

nimbus_bound_haven.text: Nimbus is being carried to the haven.

nimbus_secret.text: Nimbus is the captain's secret; his card says TELL NO ONE.

nimbus_rocks_ship.text: When Nimbus flinches at thunder, his thrashing rocks the whole ship.

gentle_calms_nimbus.text: Nimbus steadies when someone small stays close and gentle with him.

strap_pins_fin.text: A twisted harness strap pins Nimbus's left fin flat.

bree_nimbus_song.text: Bree and Nimbus share a three-note humming song.

fin_still_pinned.text: The harness strap is still twisted around Nimbus's fin.

bree_freed_fin.text: Bree untangled the harness strap from Nimbus's fin.

pip_calms_nimbus.text: Pip's purr calms Nimbus and steadies the ship.

main_stair_jammed.text: The storm has jammed the door of the main stair to the bridge.

crew_fought_hard_way.text: The crew had to fight the ship through the storm the hard way.

captain_calls_stowaway.text: Captain Quill knows Bree is a stowaway and calls her Stowaway.

bosun_learns_nimbus.text: The bosun learns from Bree that a whale is in the hold.

speaking_tube.text: A speaking tube runs from the wheelhouse straight down to Nimbus's hold.

envelope_tearing_aft.text: The balloon's envelope is tearing along a seam aft.

crew_dont_know.text: The crew do not know what they are fighting.

cargo_door_open.text: The storm has torn the hold's great cargo door half open to the sky.

captain_asks_ten_minutes.text: The captain needs Nimbus still for ten minutes to climb out of the storm.

shout_frightens.text: Bree's shout down the speaking tube booms like thunder and sets Nimbus thrashing.

cirrus_out_of_storm.text: The Cirrus comes safely through the storm.

nimbus_reaches_haven.text: Nimbus reaches the haven and joins his own kind.

bree_joins_crew.text: Bree is welcomed aboard the Cirrus as one of the crew.

patch_closed.text: The tear in the envelope is patched closed.

bree_stuck_rigging.text: Bree froze in the rigging and the rigger had to leave the tear to fetch her.

bree_never_crossed_live_rope.text: Bree has never crossed live rope.

inner_bay.text: A padded, windowless inner bay opens off the hold.

nimbus_flies.text: Nimbus flies free on both fins and guides the Cirrus through the storm.

nimbus_kite.text: With one fin pinned, Nimbus hangs behind the ship on his harness line like a kite.

captain_hunters.text: The secret protects Nimbus, because hunters pay well for a sky-whale and sailors talk in port.

crew_learns_nimbus.text: The crew learn that a sky-whale calf is aboard.

n_open.event: Bree, who has always dreamed of the sky, hides as a stowaway in a rope coil as the airship Cirrus casts off under Captain Quill.

n_start.event: Bree peeks out of the coil and sees four ways off the boarding deck as a sailor walks her way.

a_eng1.event: In the roaring engine room a stoker sings to the engine; a catwalk goes the long way round, the open floor runs behind him.

a_eng_deep.event: Past the pistons Bree finds labeled dials and a ladder down to the coal bunkers, where something small scuffles.

a_eng_a.event: Bree reads the dials; HOLD reads WARM with a chalked note to keep it warm by the captain's order.

a_eng_a2.event: Through the low hatch a curious mew answers Bree's hello and draws her along the passage.

a_eng_b.event: In the coal bunkers Bree finds tiny paw prints leading to a loose hatch, and hears a mew-chirp beyond it.

a_eng_b2.event: Bree follows the sooty paw prints along a warm service passage toward a mew until they fade.

a_eng_conv.event: The passage ends in a nook of rope and canvas, where bright eyes blink at Bree from behind a SAILCLOTH crate.

a_eng_risk.event: Halfway across the open floor the stoker hears her and starts to turn; Bree must hide or bluff.

a_eng_recover.event: Hidden behind the coal chute, Bree waits until the stoker blames the light, then slips into the pipe maze.

e_set_eng.event: Bree's bucket bluff fails; the stoker takes her to the purser, and on his bench she hears a sad low note below.

b_hold1.event: In the cargo hold a deckhand grumbles about forty sacks of feed; a tidy aisle and a loose net lead on.

b_hold_deep.event: Deep in the aisle Bree sees crates under a silver crest and a barrel tunnel with grey fur on its rim.

b_hold_a.event: The crest is a sail-finned fish over clouds, stenciled HAVEN and FEED, 40 SACKS, and the sacks smell of the sea.

b_hold_a2.event: On a walkway a small creature crosses Bree's path, mew-chirps, and leads her toward a crate.

b_hold_b.event: In the barrel tunnel Bree finds a rag nest with a licked sardine tin; somebody small lives here.

b_hold_b2.event: A mew-chirp leads Bree along a walkway toward the middle of the ship, past a second sardine tin.

b_hold_conv.event: In a nook of rope and canvas, two bright eyes open behind a crate and blink hello.

b_hold_risk.event: Through the netting, unlashed crates lean toward Bree; she can scramble clear or squeeze into a gap.

b_hold_recover.event: Bree scrambles clear as the crates settle, steadies one, and takes the safer aisle deeper in.

e_set_hold.event: Boxed in by the crates, Bree is found when a grey cat fetches a deckhand; she is set ashore never knowing the cat's name.

c_nest1.event: The mast ladder splits into a sheltered inner ladder and open outside rungs with a safety line; someone whistles above.

c_nest_deep.event: Under the crow's nest floor, Bree finds a spare spyglass and a rope run while the lookout whistles overhead.

c_nest_a.event: Through the spyglass Bree learns how gasbags lift the ship and spots one tired seam near the stern.

c_nest_a2.event: In a sheltered gangway a questioning mew-chirp draws Bree down toward the middle of the ship.

c_nest_b.event: Bree slides down the rope run to a coil of canvas while the lookout calls down; a warm passage opens ahead.

c_nest_b2.event: A hopeful mew leads Bree along a snug passage toward the middle of the ship.

c_nest_conv.event: In a nook of rope and sail, patient eyes look out at Bree from behind a crate.

c_nest_risk.event: On the open rungs a gust shakes the mast; the safety clip swings near and the nest is ten rungs up.

c_nest_recover.event: Bree clips on in time, rides out the gust, and climbs back to take the sheltered ladder.

e_set_nest.event: The lookout hauls Bree into the nest, keeps her warm, says the ship flies heavy as if with a whale, and she is put down at port.

d_salon1.event: In the glowing saloon a steward serves supper; curtains and long tablecloths offer cover.

d_salon_deep.event: Behind the curtains is a service room with a case of model ships and a STEWARDS ONLY door.

d_salon_a.event: The cut-open model of the Cirrus has its lowest deck's label painted over, as if hidden.

d_salon_a2.event: Down the stewards' hallway a mew-chirp from the middle of the ship draws Bree on.

d_salon_b.event: In the pantry passage Bree eats a crust while the steward assures a lady there is no mouse aboard.

d_salon_b2.event: In a warm corridor a mew that smells bread leads Bree toward the middle of the ship.

d_salon_conv.event: In a nook of rope and sailcloth, hopeful eyes shine at Bree from behind a crate.

d_salon_risk.event: Under the tablecloths a waiter's boot nearly lands on Bree; she can roll behind a trolley or bolt for a door.

d_salon_recover.event: Behind the trolley Bree waits out the waiter, then slips behind the curtains to a room.

e_set_salon.event: Bree bolts across the saloon and the steward catches her, feeds her in the purser's office, and hints at something odder aboard.

n_friend.event: A thin grey cat steps out from behind the crate and Bree names him Pip; three ways lead from the nook as a bell rings.

f_galley1.event: In the galley the cook grumbles about forty buckets of fish mash a day for cargo; the larder stands open.

f_galley_a.event: Bree feeds Pip a tin of sardines in the larder and he purrs for the first time; then the floor lurches.

f_galley_b.event: Hiding behind the flour sacks, Pip sneezes and the cook turns.

f_galley_mid.event: Out in the tilting corridor an alarm bell clangs; Bree tucks Pip into her coat and runs toward it.

e_set_galley.event: The cook catches Bree and Pip, feeds them, keeps Pip as galley cat, and jokes about forty buckets and a whale; Bree is set ashore.

f_cabin1.event: The captain's cabin stands empty with charts; Captain Quill's voice comes from the officers' room next door.

f_cabin_a.event: Bree overhears the captain fear that he, unfed and hating noise, will wreck the ship in the storm; the crew think they haul tea.

f_cabin_b.event: The chart shows the course bending around a storm and a doodled whale marked HOME; boots approach.

f_cabin_b2.event: From behind the curtain Bree hears the first officer grumble about a seasick calf before the bell sends her running.

f_cabin_mid.event: The corridor pitches and the bell clangs; Bree tucks Pip into her coat and follows the running crew.

e_set_cabin.event: The first officer finds Bree under the chart table, where a whale sketch reads NIMBUS; she says it is a cloud.

f_rig1.event: In the inner rigging, Pip scampers ahead; a catwalk and a LIVE ROPE rope-bridge lead on.

f_rig_a.event: From the catwalk Bree hears riggers talk of an old aft seam she cannot pick out, as the first gust leans the ship.

f_rig_b.event: On the swaying rope-bridge a gust kicks it sideways, with six planks to go and a bigger gust coming.

f_rig_b2.event: Bree crosses low and slow through the second gust, and a watching rigger whistles well done.

f_rig_mid.event: The storm shakes the rigging; Bree tucks Pip into her coat and climbs down toward the bell.

e_set_rig.event: Bree runs the bridge, gets stuck in the ropes, and is clipped to a rigger who mutters about an old stern seam; she is put ashore.

n_storm.event: On the storm-lashed main deck the bosun calls all hands, and a living groan rises from the deep hold.

s_deck1.event: On the weather deck a torn control line lashes about and an officer calls for someone to belay it.

s_deck_a.event: Bree catches and cleats the line; the officer sends her below to find what is groaning.

s_deck_b.event: Clinging to a rail post, Bree sees a crate skid at her; a hatch is near, the wheelhouse far.

s_deck_mid.event: Bree follows the breathing groan down to a sealed door whose bolt the storm has shaken loose.

e_set_storm1.event: A rigger catches Bree mid-dash and wedges her in a cabin, where a sad note follows the thunder all night; no one explains it.

s_crew1.event: The crew haul a balloon rope as the bosun calls for more hands and for sand on the deck.

s_crew_a.event: Bree adds her weight to the rope until it is made fast and the crew cheer.

s_crew_b.event: Bree lugs two sand buckets as the ship heaves and one starts to tip.

s_crew_mid.event: In a lull the bosun says he knows every hand and not Bree, and asks who she is; stowaways go to the purser.

s_crew_truth.event: Bree admits she is a stowaway; the bosun laughs, keeps it quiet, and sends her to look in the sealed hold.

s_crew_dodge.event: Bree ducks away with her name kept, following the groan down to the sealed door with its bolt shaken loose.

e_set_storm2.event: Knocked down by the buckets, Bree sits out the fight while the bosun wonders aloud what groans in the sealed hold.

s_hold1.event: In the deep hold the groan is plainly alive and afraid; a sealed door has a glass hatch and a brass panel.

s_hold_a.event: Through the hatch Bree sees a huge pale shaking shape that answers Pip with a long low note.

s_hold_b.event: The brass panel, signed by Captain Quill, gives feeding, harness and calming orders: never shout, never bang.

s_hold_mid.event: Thunder jolts the bolt loose and the great door swings open; Pip leads Bree inside.

n_secret.event: Inside is Nimbus, a sky-whale calf cut from a hunter's net and bound for the haven; he flinches at thunder and steadies at Pip's mew.

p_save1.event: Bree edges close and sees a harness strap twisted around Nimbus's left fin, making him jerk and rock the ship.

p_save_a.event: Bree hums a made-up three-note song and Nimbus hums it back, though his fin stays pinned.

p_save_b.event: Bree works the strap free of Nimbus's fin and he calms and lays the fin beside her.

p_pip1.event: Pip, full of sardines, curls against Nimbus's nose and purrs, and the whale and the ship go still.

p_save_mid.event: Knowing what steadies Nimbus, Bree climbs to the wheelhouse and tells the captain she has been with her whale.

p_reveal1.event: The main stair to the bridge is jammed; a long dry stair or a short flooded passage remain.

p_reveal_a.event: Climbing the long stair, Bree rehearses telling the captain her whale's fear of thunder rocks the ship.

p_reveal_a2.event: A mate bars the officers' corridor to passengers; Bree, truthfully no passenger, ducks past.

p_reveal_mid.event: At the wheelhouse Bree delivers her practiced line to the captain, and every head turns.

e_set_reveal.event: The flooded passage turns Bree back; she arrives too late, and the captain wraps her in a blanket.

p_people1.event: Bree runs for help with Pip; the bosun roars at the mast and the captain stands alone at a window.

p_people_a.event: The bosun believes Bree because she told him the truth before, and charges off to fetch the captain.

p_people_cold.event: The bosun does not believe a girl he does not know, but carries her up to the captain anyway.

p_people_b.event: Bree tells the captain she has seen Nimbus through the storm-opened door, and the captain walks her to the wheel.

p_people_mid.event: Bree and Pip come into the chaotic wheelhouse where no one has time to question her.

n_bridge.event: The ship drops; the captain names Nimbus as the cause, shows a speaking tube to his hold, and asks Bree where to stand.

b_steer1.event: The captain needs Nimbus still for ten minutes; at the speaking tube Bree must choose how to reach him.

b_steer_ok.event: Bree hums three low notes down the tube and Nimbus answers and stills; the ship answers the helm.

b_steer_ok2.event: Bree hums through the worst until the Cirrus rises into calm moonlit air.

e_set_final.event: Bree shouts down the tube, it booms like thunder, Nimbus thrashes, and the captain sets her ashore at port.

e_win_save_ship.event: The captain thanks Bree for forty minutes of humming and calls her one of the ship's own; Nimbus reaches the haven.

b_steer_purr.event: Bree holds the sardine-full Pip to the tube and his amplified purr calms Nimbus.

e_win_purr.event: Pip purrs the ship out of the storm, is made ship's cat, and Bree stays aboard as his keeper.

b_patch1.event: Under the envelope a seam has torn; the rigger needs someone small who has crossed live rope, or a hand on the winch.

b_patch_ok.event: Bree says she crossed the rope-bridge tonight; the rigger who saw her clips her on and she threads the patch.

b_patch_alt.event: Bree works the winch while a thin ship's boy reaches the tear, and the patch draws tight.

e_win_patch.event: The patch holds; Nimbus sleeps, and the captain signs Bree on as rigger's mate, with Pip signing too.

e_win_steer.event: Bree hangs on the winch until the ship rights; the crew cheer her, and the captain thanks her for her cargo.

e_set_aloft.event: Never having crossed live rope, Bree freezes in the rigging; the rigger fetches her and the ship limps to an emergency mooring.

b_free1.event: Below, the captain says Nimbus wants out through the storm-torn cargo door; a quiet padded inner bay is the other way.

b_free_ok.event: Bree says she freed the fin herself; the captain slips the harness and Nimbus rises into the storm on both fins.

b_free_ok2.event: Nimbus circles the ship singing, the crew stare, and he leads the Cirrus through a gap in the clouds.

e_win_free.event: Nimbus leads the ship to the haven and joins his kind; the captain credits Bree for freeing the fin and offers a berth.

b_free_alt.event: Bree hums Nimbus into the padded inner bay, where he settles and the ship steadies.

e_win_friend.event: Bree sits with Nimbus all night; at the haven the keepers marvel and Bree watches him join his kind.

e_neu_kite.event: With one fin still strapped, Nimbus hangs behind the ship like a kite; they reach port but he must rest before the haven.

b_tell1.event: Bree says the crew should know; the captain explains the secret guards Nimbus from hunters as the crew wait.

b_tell_crew.event: Bree tells the crew; the bosun vouches for her honesty and sends the port watch to the hold.

e_win_crew.event: The port watch hums Nimbus through the night; the crew make Bree a shipmate and the captain salutes her.

b_tell_doubt.event: Bree tells the crew and they laugh; the bosun does not know her, and no one moves.

b_tell_captain.event: The captain tells the crew herself and offers Bree a place at Nimbus's side or a warm bunk.

e_win_captain.event: Bree hums beside Nimbus with the captain through the storm and is written into the log as crew.

e_neu_home.event: Bree sleeps through the end of the storm; at port the captain invites her back when she is taller.

b_tell_reveal.event: Bree drags the bosun and crew down to the sealed hold, where they see the calf and begin to hum.

e_win_discovery.event: The crew hum Nimbus through the storm, the cook learns where his forty buckets go, and the captain asks Bree to sail with them.

e_set_eng.gift: the purser's 'no ticket' and a sad note through the bench: something alive and unhappy rides below

e_set_hold.gift: a nameless grey cat who rescues her, and the wish to go back and learn his name

e_set_nest.gift: the lookout's joke that the ship flies heavy, as if a whale were aboard

e_set_salon.gift: the steward's hint that a stowaway is not the oddest thing aboard

e_set_galley.gift: Pip finds a home as galley cat, and the cook's forty buckets and joke about a whale

e_set_cabin.gift: the NIMBUS sketch and the officer's too-quick claim that it is only a cloud

e_set_rig.gift: the rigger's lesson to cross live rope low and slow, and talk of the old stern seam

e_set_storm1.gift: the low note that follows the thunder, and the hatch that held the answer

e_set_storm2.gift: the bosun's own curiosity about the sealed hold, a mystery they share

e_set_reveal.gift: the captain's kindness and her lesson that a slow, wet messenger still arrives

e_set_final.gift: the lesson that Nimbus hates a raised voice; softness, not volume, would have reached him

e_win_save_ship.gift: humming steadies the whale and saves the ship; Bree is named one of the ship's own

e_win_purr.gift: the fed stray's purr saves the ship; Pip becomes ship's cat and Bree his keeper

e_win_patch.gift: the rope-bridge practice pays off; Bree mends the envelope and becomes rigger's mate

e_win_steer.gift: honest hard work on the winch earns Bree a berth and the captain's quiet thanks

e_set_aloft.gift: the reason to retry: the rope-bridge in the inner rigging would have taught her live rope

e_win_free.gift: the freed fin lets Nimbus fly and lead the ship home to the haven

e_win_friend.gift: a calm night beside Nimbus, and watching him join his own kind at the haven

e_neu_kite.gift: a whale flown like a kite, and the clue that freeing his fin first would let him fly

e_win_crew.gift: honesty with the bosun earns the crew's trust; Bree becomes a shipmate

e_win_captain.gift: the captain's trust and her name written in the log as crew

e_neu_home.gift: a real storm, a sky-whale seen eye to eye, and an invitation to come back taller

e_win_discovery.gift: the secret becomes a wonder shared by the whole crew, and Bree sails on
